tools_helpful.evidence: session-log L183/L187: bootstrap copied 18 source files verbatim and rewrote Windows.UI.Xaml->Microsoft.UI.Xaml in 12/18 .cs/.xaml; Test-Path MIGRATION-MAPPING.md returned True (L213).
Clean build achieved; validator/build healthcheck passed; app launched and was captured by the scorer (PID 15288).

tool_limitations.limitation: Validator gate checks namespace residue, TODO residue, mapping integrity, manifest, build cleanliness and runtime smoke — but has NO check that user-visible text (control Content/Text, headers, descriptive paragraphs) copied verbatim by the bootstrap survived the agent's edits. A page regenerated from scratch passes the gate as long as it compiles and the controls are wired.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Snapshot visible-text tokens at bootstrap and WARN in the validator when a non-deferred XAML no longer contains them.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent authored all 10 Scenario*.xaml by looping a PowerShell here-string and Set-Content over the target files, instead of editing the verbatim-copied originals.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Agent regenerated the scenario pages from scratch. The freshly authored markup contained only the wired controls (Button with Default_Click + PlaybackControl) and a paraphrased button label ('Set <Cat> category and play a file'); the original SDK-sample 'Description:' text block and the original 'Select Audio File' button label were discarded.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved — the regenerated pages shipped; scorer recorded relabeled-control + missing-element discrepancies on all 10 scenarios (score 50/100, 10/10 partial).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: SKILL Fidelity rule should forbid regenerating/overwriting whole XAML files (scripted Set-Content/here-strings) and require verbatim preservation of visible/static text, not just controls/names/handlers; plus a validator WARN that flags dropped visible text.

missing_tooling.need: A fidelity guard that detects when human-visible text (labels, descriptions) present in the verbatim-copied source XAML is missing from the migrated XAML.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: All 10 relabeled-control + 10 missing-element discrepancies that capped the score at 50/100.

env_issues.issue: Headless DirectComposition capture returns blank surface for WinUI 3 swapchains (scorer note).
env_issues.workaround: Scorer relied on UIA tree + source; not a migration-skill issue.
